purpose: FBS-235: the external criteria of US-19801, driving bin/rcf.js against fixture projects (e2e); todo cases until FBS-235's round DEFINE
title: US-19801 external criteria (FBS-235)

testCases.description: with HEAD adding AC-101-2 flagged external over a base holding the unflagged AC-101-1, rcf define validate --base <base> exits 0 with no "[error]" line and no verification line for AC-101-2 on stderr
testCases.testPointer: test/define/verification-end-state.test.js::AC-19801-1: with HEAD adding AC-101-2 flagged external over a base holding the unflagged AC-101-1, rcf define validate --base <base> exits 0 with no "[error]" line and no verification line for AC-101-2 on stderr

testCases.description: with HEAD adding AC-101-2 with no verification, rcf define validate --base <base> exits 3 with "[error] verification AC-101-2 is new since <base7> and carries no verification flag (external | testOnly)"
testCases.testPointer: test/define/verification-end-state.test.js::AC-19801-2: with HEAD adding AC-101-2 with no verification, rcf define validate --base <base> exits 3 with "[error] verification AC-101-2 is new since <base7> and carries no verification flag (external | testOnly)"

testCases.description: a HEAD changing only the then text of the unflagged AC-101-1 exits 3 with its "is amended since <base7>" line; a HEAD changing only its testable or only its ownerRef is not amended and exits 0
testCases.testPointer: test/define/verification-end-state.test.js::AC-19801-3: a HEAD changing only the then text of the unflagged AC-101-1 exits 3 with its "is amended since <base7>" line; a HEAD changing only its testable or only its ownerRef is not amended and exits 0

testCases.description: outside git, or in git with no origin/main and no --base, validate over an unflagged new criterion exits 0 with exactly one "[warn] verification: no base ref; new and amended criteria not checked" line; --base naming a missing ref exits 2 "[error] usage --base <ref> does not resolve"
testCases.testPointer: test/define/verification-end-state.test.js::AC-19801-4: outside git, or in git with no origin/main and no --base, validate over an unflagged new criterion exits 0 with exactly one "[warn] verification: no base ref; new and amended criteria not checked" line; --base naming a missing ref exits 2 "[error] usage --base <ref> does not resolve"

testCases.description: a retired criterion is never required to carry verification and never in the verification report, new or amended since the base; and the rule never changes the exit code of validate for another finding
